security_audit.summary: The reviewed files are Markdown guidance for Lark contact lookup through lark-cli, not executable source code. Most high and medium static alerts are false positives from Markdown links, inline code, Chinese text, and readable documentation. Directory lookup capabilities are legitimate but privacy-sensitive, and parent-directory shared-file prerequisites should be packaged more safely.

remediation.suggestion: Inline the required authentication and safety guidance, or package the shared guidance as an audited dependency instead of using ../ reads.
Add guidance to confirm the user has a business need, limit searches, and avoid sharing phone, email, or open_id values unnecessarily.

content.user_title: Find Lark Contacts and User Details
content.value_statement: Teams often need reliable contact details inside Lark. This skill searches users and retrieves profile information through lark-cli.
actual_capabilities: Search Lark users by name, email, or phone keyword.
Retrieve the current authenticated user profile without a user ID.
Retrieve a specified user by open_id, union_id, or user_id.
Use lark-cli contact shortcuts for search and profile lookup.
Support pagination tokens and readable output options.
limitations: Requires lark-cli to be installed and authenticated.
Can only access users visible to the current Lark token.
Does not create, update, or delete contact records.
May return sensitive directory data governed by organization policy.

use_cases.title: Find a colleague quickly
use_cases.description: Search by name or email and identify the correct Lark user profile.

use_cases.title: Resolve user identifiers
use_cases.description: Find open_id, union_id, or user_id values needed for Lark workflows.

use_cases.title: Check current account context
use_cases.description: Retrieve the authenticated user profile before running contact-related tasks.

prompt_templates.title: Search by name
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Lark contacts for a colleague named Alice Chen and show the most relevant matches.

prompt_templates.title: Get my profile
prompt_templates.prompt: Get my current Lark user profile and summarize the key contact fields.

prompt_templates.title: Find and verify a user
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for the user with this email address, then retrieve the matching profile details.

prompt_templates.title: Paginate a broad search
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for users matching the keyword sales, review the first page, and continue only if more results are available.

output_examples.input: Search for Alice Chen in Lark contacts.
output_examples.output: The result lists matching users, including display name, department context, and identifiers when available.

output_examples.input: Get the profile for a known open_id.
output_examples.output: The response summarizes the selected user profile and notes any fields hidden by permission limits.

output_examples.input: Check the current authenticated Lark user.
output_examples.output: The response identifies the current account and provides key contact fields visible to the token.

best_practices: Search with the most specific name, email, or phone value available.
Confirm the business purpose before retrieving another user profile.
Use pagination tokens instead of increasing page size unnecessarily.
anti_patterns: Do not export broad contact lists without authorization.
Do not share phone, email, or open_id values outside approved workflows.
Do not assume missing fields mean the user does not exist.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It searches Lark contacts and retrieves user profile details through lark-cli contact shortcuts.

faq.question: Does it require Lark authentication?
faq.answer: Yes. lark-cli must be installed and authenticated with access to the requested contact data.

faq.question: Can it search by email or phone number?
faq.answer: Yes. The search shortcut accepts keyword queries such as names, email addresses, or phone numbers.

faq.question: Can it retrieve my own profile?
faq.answer: Yes. The get-user shortcut can retrieve the current authenticated user when no user ID is provided.

faq.question: Can it modify the contact directory?
faq.answer: No. The documented shortcuts search users and read profile information only.

faq.question: Why might a user lookup fail?
faq.answer: Lookups can fail when the current token lacks permission or the organization limits contact visibility.
